title: Edge case: rambling Q&A answer with mixed signals
title_ko: 경계 사례: 신호가 섞인 질의응답에서 장황한 답변
description: Blind check added after the detector thresholds were fixed. The answer mentions an expected keyword but rambles, so keyword matching may treat it as on-topic.

events.transcript_chunk: To wrap up: attention-aware documents are feasible today, and next is a field deployment.

ground_truth.note: Fast, but it is the closing line.

events.audience_question: Does it work for people reading in a second language?

events.transcript_chunk: Great question. So the glossary pop-ups, and also, um, the regression detection, and the webcam, it runs at thirty frames, and there are many parameters we tuned...

ground_truth.note: The answer drifts into implementation details instead of answering yes/no plus one reason.

events.transcript_chunk: In short, the glossary helps with unfamiliar terms, and a study with non-native readers is future work.

events.audience_question: What happens in a dark room?

events.transcript_chunk: In a dark room the webcam accuracy drops, which is our main limitation.
